page.overview:
Who is Professor Onihashi?

The master swordsmith of the Arashikage Clan and master of characters such as Firefly, Zartan, and T'Jbang.

It is unknown how long Professor Onihashi was the master swordsmith for the Arashikage Clan, but it was long enough that he was considered an honorary member.

As a result the dishonor of his own student taking the life of the Hard Master, Onihashi committed suicide.

Professor Onihashi's hexagram tattoo was not the same as the rest of the Arashikage clan.
